name: Fool's Stout

meta.previous: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout

summary: In Booty Bay, travelers seek more Fool's Stout for the Shimmering Flats raceway. Crank Fizzlebub needs twelve flasks of Zanzil's mixture to brew another batch.

sections.title: A Second Batch
sections.body: Travelers bound for the gnomes at the raceway may find their Fool's Stout has expired before they arrive. In Booty Bay, Crank Fizzlebub can brew a replacement. The goblin needs twelve flasks of Zanzil's mixture, and offers compensation for fetching them, with a little extra for discretion.

faq.q: Who offers to brew Fool's Stout?
faq.answer: In Booty Bay in southern Stranglethorn Vale, Crank Fizzlebub offers to brew Fool's Stout.

faq.q: What ingredients does Crank Fizzlebub need?
faq.answer: Crank Fizzlebub needs twelve flasks of Zanzil's mixture to brew another batch of Fool's Stout.

faq.q: Why would someone need another batch of Fool's Stout?
faq.answer: Fool's Stout evaporates after two hours, so travelers who miss that window need fresh ingredients for a replacement.

faq.q: Where is the brew intended to go?
faq.answer: The brew is meant for the gnomes at the raceway.
